newsitem.title: USA: USG Corp Q4 net climbs as revenues improve.
newsitem.headline: USG Corp Q4 net climbs as revenues improve.

text.p: USG Corp said Monday stronger home construction starts helped fuel solid increases in revenues and net income in the fourth quarter.
The company said revenues reached $668 million, up from $602 million one year ago. Net income reached $13 million, versus a loss of $25 million in the same period in 1995.
USG said earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation and amortization (EBITDA) reached $123 million, compared to $102 million one year ago.
To meet customer demand, the company operated its wallboard plants to near capacity, USG said.
USG is a building products manufacturing company.
Its shares were unchanged Monday afternoon at 34.
